title: Enforce extra_float_digits = 1; the correctness pass depends on it and nothing checks it
spec: Spawned by T-6. T-6 passes ONLY at extra_float_digits = 1. Measured at the other two settings on the same batteries: 62 wrong numbers at efd 0 and 66 at efd -3 (spikes/T-6/out/VC_sub_extreme_efd{0,-3}_recursive.txt) - the M3 value-channel truncation, where Postgres prints fewer digits than a double carries. T-6's fix 2.1 declares efd != 1 a CONFIGURATION DEFECT rather than a compiler defect, which is only legitimate if the configuration is actually guaranteed. Today nothing guarantees it: the setting is a session GUC any connection can change and the compiled path does not assert it. Required: the generated query (or its session setup) pins it, AND a check that fails loudly rather than returning a short number if the session reports anything else. Reading it back once per session is enough; T-3's efd_control.py already shows the read-back pattern.
